summary: Myseum.AI, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase the amount of common stock it may sell under an existing at-the-market (ATM) Sales Agreement with The Benchmark Company, LLC by up to $2,754,500. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, not a special situation. It updates eligibility limits and discloses prior sales of 750,000 shares for ~$3.3 million. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist event is present. The filing routine capital-raising.
